## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

## SERVICES

### Pre Construction Planning

[Turnkey Framing]

### Turnkey Framing

We offer gross maximum price contracts for turnkey multifamily, build-for-rent communities, and
other lumber related projects.


We offer trusses and siding in our turnkey number.

[Drywall finish]

### "Own the Wall"

Unique to Coop Construction, we offer a turnkey solution that encompasses rough framing through to
the final coat of paint. This includes insulation, dry-wall, as well as framing and paint.

ABOUT

## ABOUT

Introducing our premier turnkey framing company. We specialize in multifamily framing where
experience, safety, and quality come together to create exceptional results. With an impressive 50
years of combined industry expertise, we are dedicated to delivering top-notch framing solutions
tailored to meet your specific needs.

At our company, safety is our top priority. We understand the importance of a secure working
environment, not only for our team but also for the success of your project. Our highly skilled
professionals adhere to the strictest safety protocols, ensuring that every aspect of the framing
process is executed with utmost care and caution.

Quality is the cornerstone of our business. We believe that every project deserves the finest
craftsmanship, and our team is committed to delivering excellence at every stage. From meticulous
planning to precise execution, we pay attention to every detail, guaranteeing superior results that
surpass expectations.

any of our storage buildings for an additional charge. For most buildings, the cost for paint is 12%

### Have questions? Here are answers to some of our most frequently asked questions.

### 1. WHAT IS INCLUDED IN THE BASE PRICE OF A SHED?

The base price of all of our sheds include, a 4′ wide single door, delivery and on-site construction
(within 70 miles of Springville, Utah. Delivery fees will be charged for distances of more than 70
miles).  All of base models come primed and ready to paint.  All other options such as door
upgrades, windows, vents, skylights, shelving, lofts and more are available for an additional cost.
 [Click here for custom options pricing.][66]

#### 2. IS PAINT INCLUDED IN THE BASE PRICE OF MY SHED?

Many of our customers want to paint their own shed and as such, we do not include paint in the base
price (this is a standard practice in the shed industry). However, you may add the paint option to
any of our storage buildings for an additional charge. For most buildings, the cost for paint is 12%
of the base price. However, it may be more for some models such as our Coop ‘De Ville chicken coops
that require a lot more paint than a standard shed.

  I love helping small business owners bring their ideas to life and giving them the confidence,

  With a degree in Business Marketing and years of real-world experience, I design with strategy in

  set!”

  cleaning, shacks, and high-temperature and high-humidity environment can easily produce a large
  amount of ammonia gas, which has high water solubility (1L water at 0 ℃) Soluble 907g) is often
  adsorbed on the chicken's skin, mucous membranes and ocular conjunctiva, thereby irritating it and
  causing various inflammations.

  ##### [Do raising chickens need to clean up the waterline? ][83]
  
  In order to avoid contamination by external bacteria during chicken breeding, the waterline of the
  chicken house is completely closed. Many chicken farms only supply water according to time and
  neglect disinfection.
  
  January 23,2020

  store-bought ingredients. The owner joined us for a few minutes, sharing stories about how he

# Frequently Asked Questions

Buying a premium chicken coop is an important decision. Below, you’ll find answers about our coops,
payment options, delivery process, build times, customization, returns, and support.

[General Questions][100] [Ordering & Payment][101] [Shipping & Delivery][102] [Coop Selection &
Sizing][103] [Product Features & Customization][104] [Returns, Damage & Support][105]

## General Questions

Basic information about Cluck & Coop, our products, and how we operate.

What is Cluck & Coop?

Cluck & Coop is an online retailer of premium chicken coops serving customers across the 48
contiguous United States. We offer carefully selected coop styles from trusted U.S. manufacturing
partners, including Amish-built wood coops and SnapLock Formex plastic coops.

Where are your coops made?

Our Amish-built wood coops are manufactured in the United States by our trusted supplier partners.
Our SnapLock Formex plastic coops are also made by a U.S. manufacturer. We focus on products that
are durable, practical, and suitable for long-term backyard chicken keeping.

Are you the manufacturer?

Cluck & Coop is an online retailer, not the direct manufacturer. We work with carefully selected
U.S. supplier partners who build and ship the coops directly to customers. This allows us to offer
premium coops while providing customer support, payment options, and buying guidance through Cluck &
Coop.

Do you have a physical showroom?

Cluck & Coop is an online store. We do not currently operate a physical showroom. However, we
provide product photos, videos, descriptions, specifications, and support to help you choose the
right coop.

## Ordering & Payment

Answers about placing orders, requesting invoices, financing through SweetPay subject to approval,
credit card payments, and bank transfer options.

How do I place an order?

You can place an order directly on our website by selecting your coop, adding it to your cart, and
completing checkout. If you prefer to review details first, you can use our **Request Invoice**
option and we will follow up with payment options and next steps.

What payment methods do you accept?

We offer multiple payment options:
* Credit card
* Debit card
* Shop Pay, if available at checkout
* Financing options through SweetPay, if eligible
* Bank transfer / wire transfer / bank deposit
* Invoice-based payment for customers who prefer assistance before completing the purchase

Do you offer financing?

Yes. Financing may be available through **SweetPay**. Approval and terms are provided by SweetPay or
its participating lenders. Cluck & Coop does not make lending decisions or guarantee approval.

Do you offer a discount for bank transfer?

We may offer a bank transfer savings option when available. If a product page displays a “Save 3%
with bank transfer” message, the savings amount is calculated based on the product price. Final
payment instructions will be provided after checkout or through an invoice request.

Can I request an invoice before paying?

Yes. You can request an invoice before completing your purchase. This is a good option if you want
to confirm the product, delivery expectations, payment method, or financing through SweetPay which
is subject to approval, before proceeding.

What happens after I request an invoice?

After you submit an invoice request, our team will review the details and respond with an invoice or
next steps. We aim to respond within **48 hours**.

## Shipping & Delivery

Information about where we ship, delivery timelines, freight delivery, curbside delivery, and how to
prepare for delivery.

Where do you ship?

We currently ship to the **48 contiguous United States**. We do not currently ship to Alaska,
Hawaii, U.S. territories, APO/FPO/DPO addresses, or international destinations.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery timelines depend on the product type:
* **Amish-built wood coops:** typically 4–6 weeks from order date
* **SnapLock Formex plastic coops:** typically 5–10 business days, depending on availability and
  destination

Timelines may vary due to demand, production schedules, weather, and carrier availability.

How are Amish-built wood coops delivered?

Most Amish-built wood coops are shipped by freight or private delivery carrier. Delivery is
typically curbside unless otherwise stated. The carrier may contact you to schedule a delivery
appointment.

Are the coops delivered fully assembled?

All Amish-built wood coops are delivered fully assembled. SnapLock Formex plastic coops are shipped
unassembled and require customer assembly.

What should I do to prepare for delivery?

Before delivery, please make sure:
* Your delivery location is accessible
* The area is level and ready for placement
* There is enough room for the delivery vehicle
* You have help available if the coop needs to be moved after curbside delivery

For larger coops, a prepared gravel pad or level foundation may be recommended.

Will the delivery driver place the coop exactly where I want it?

Delivery placement depends on the delivery method, carrier, property access, and product type.
Unless white-glove placement or special placement is explicitly confirmed, delivery should be
expected as curbside or nearest accessible point.

What if my property has limited access?

If your driveway, road, gate, trees, slope, or property layout may limit access, contact us before
ordering. This helps us review delivery expectations and avoid delays or additional charges.

Helpful Answers

# Frequently Asked Questions

Buying a premium chicken coop is an important decision. Below, you’ll find answers about our coops,
payment options, delivery process, build times, customization, returns, and support.

[General Questions][100] [Ordering & Payment][101] [Shipping & Delivery][102] [Coop Selection &
Sizing][103] [Product Features & Customization][104] [Returns, Damage & Support][105]

## General Questions

Basic information about Cluck & Coop, our products, and how we operate.

What is Cluck & Coop?

Cluck & Coop is an online retailer of premium chicken coops serving customers across the 48
contiguous United States. We offer carefully selected coop styles from trusted U.S. manufacturing
partners, including Amish-built wood coops and SnapLock Formex plastic coops.

Where are your coops made?

Our Amish-built wood coops are manufactured in the United States by our trusted supplier partners.
Our SnapLock Formex plastic coops are also made by a U.S. manufacturer. We focus on products that
are durable, practical, and suitable for long-term backyard chicken keeping.

Are you the manufacturer?

Cluck & Coop is an online retailer, not the direct manufacturer. We work with carefully selected
U.S. supplier partners who build and ship the coops directly to customers. This allows us to offer
premium coops while providing customer support, payment options, and buying guidance through Cluck &
Coop.

Do you have a physical showroom?

Cluck & Coop is an online store. We do not currently operate a physical showroom. However, we
provide product photos, videos, descriptions, specifications, and support to help you choose the
right coop.

## Ordering & Payment

Answers about placing orders, requesting invoices, financing through SweetPay subject to approval,
credit card payments, and bank transfer options.

How do I place an order?

You can place an order directly on our website by selecting your coop, adding it to your cart, and
completing checkout. If you prefer to review details first, you can use our **Request Invoice**
option and we will follow up with payment options and next steps.

What payment methods do you accept?

We offer multiple payment options:
* Credit card
* Debit card
* Shop Pay, if available at checkout
* Financing options through SweetPay, if eligible
* Bank transfer / wire transfer / bank deposit
* Invoice-based payment for customers who prefer assistance before completing the purchase

Do you offer financing?

Yes. Financing may be available through **SweetPay**. Approval and terms are provided by SweetPay or
its participating lenders. Cluck & Coop does not make lending decisions or guarantee approval.

Do you offer a discount for bank transfer?

We may offer a bank transfer savings option when available. If a product page displays a “Save 3%
with bank transfer” message, the savings amount is calculated based on the product price. Final
payment instructions will be provided after checkout or through an invoice request.

Can I request an invoice before paying?

Yes. You can request an invoice before completing your purchase. This is a good option if you want
to confirm the product, delivery expectations, payment method, or financing through SweetPay which
is subject to approval, before proceeding.

What happens after I request an invoice?

After you submit an invoice request, our team will review the details and respond with an invoice or
next steps. We aim to respond within **48 hours**.

## Shipping & Delivery

Information about where we ship, delivery timelines, freight delivery, curbside delivery, and how to
prepare for delivery.

Where do you ship?

We currently ship to the **48 contiguous United States**. We do not currently ship to Alaska,
Hawaii, U.S. territories, APO/FPO/DPO addresses, or international destinations.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery timelines depend on the product type:
* **Amish-built wood coops:** typically 4–6 weeks from order date
* **SnapLock Formex plastic coops:** typically 5–10 business days, depending on availability and
  destination

Timelines may vary due to demand, production schedules, weather, and carrier availability.

How are Amish-built wood coops delivered?

Most Amish-built wood coops are shipped by freight or private delivery carrier. Delivery is
typically curbside unless otherwise stated. The carrier may contact you to schedule a delivery
appointment.

Are the coops delivered fully assembled?

All Amish-built wood coops are delivered fully assembled. SnapLock Formex plastic coops are shipped
unassembled and require customer assembly.

What should I do to prepare for delivery?

Before delivery, please make sure:
* Your delivery location is accessible
* The area is level and ready for placement
* There is enough room for the delivery vehicle
* You have help available if the coop needs to be moved after curbside delivery

For larger coops, a prepared gravel pad or level foundation may be recommended.

Will the delivery driver place the coop exactly where I want it?

Delivery placement depends on the delivery method, carrier, property access, and product type.
Unless white-glove placement or special placement is explicitly confirmed, delivery should be
expected as curbside or nearest accessible point.

What if my property has limited access?

If your driveway, road, gate, trees, slope, or property layout may limit access, contact us before
ordering. This helps us review delivery expectations and avoid delays or additional charges.

## CHICKEN COOPS - WOOD V PLASTIC - WHICH DO YOU CHOOSE?

Perhaps the biggest decision when getting chickens will be the coop, the hen coop needs to provide a
safe house for your new brood, be easy to clean and last a long time.

In the contest for the best chicken coop design the material it is constructed from will play a very
large part so; which material is the best, the safest, most durable, longest lasting and easiest to
clean…? Let's take a look…Appearance 

If you are on our website, we are going to assume you are a pragmatic buyer wanting a strong coop to
last a long time so it’s likely that looks are not top of your buying criteria, that said we still
think our plastic coops look good in the traditional hen house style, not like something out of the
Lakeland catalogue… have a look at our gallery to see for yourselves. 

 

Coop Cleanliness 

Healthy chickens need a healthy coop! An easy to clean home helps to prevent poorly birds, stops
disease spreading and may even increase the number of eggs you get! Humans know that the healthier
our homes, the healthier our children - why not the same for our hens?

When it’s new your Timber hen house can look good, there is no doubting that but as it gets older
how clean will it keep? Whether you have had experience with trying to clean a timber chicken coop
before or even just experience with cleaning your patio furniture or maintaining your garden fence
you know timber isn’t easy to clean and the ongoing painting is a nuisance. Without maintenance (and
even eventually with) rot sets in - even whilst quite new timber starts to soften, it absorbs
moisture - the perfect environment for bacteria and pathogens. 

 

Getting a pressure washer out for chicken coop used to be the thing of dreams! But with a well-built
plastic coop a quick blast is all that is needed. Try it with a wooden coop and you can kiss goodbye
to your investment or at the very least have a soggy timber house to return your brood to. Plastic
is the best way to go if you want to maintain a disease-free environment, with smooth surfaces that
don’t let in the pathogens or bacteria and are easy to clean.

Chicken Coop Strength

You don't need to be a rocket scientist to know that plastic is stronger than timber, many products
that used to be made from wood are now made from thinner plastics and are more robust - our coops
are made from plastic board which is thicker than most manufacturers timber! The best of both
worlds! Wood can crack, split, warp, swell, splinter, rot… the list goes on and on….. whilst plastic
will literally last forever… and without maintenance! 

So for strength it has to be plastic every time, you can literally take a sledgehammer to ours
without causing damage. That's why we offer the longest guarantees, what is there to go wrong?  No
wood to rot, no fixings to rust. We know our coops will be here much longer than we will!

 

Weatherproof 

Any coop when it’s brand new should keep out the rain, the question comes after a year or two and
the timber or roofing felt has deteriorated or the paint worn off.

Damp conditions in a coop will lead to all sorts of problems with your hens but also mean you end up
adding extra bedding and then being faced with layers of wet straw on clean out time. Do yourself
(and your hens) a favour and choose a material which is inherently waterproof to start with. 

 

Plastic Chicken Coop Costs 

Money will always come into your buying decision, so which is cheapest….? The original outlay on a
timber coop may well be less but the whole life costs will be significantly more. Value is the
initial price plus any maintenance cost divided by the lifespan, when you do this, you soon see
which is most cost efficient. The interesting thing that has never been considered is resale value.
With a plastic coop dismantled and scrubbed it is as good as new, ready to be advertised on Ebay and
sent via a courier.

 

Obviously, there are different levels of quality of timber houses available and lifespans can be
argued but using our experience and being very modest with saying a plastic coop will last only
twice as long these are some example figures. Whichever way you look at it, a plastic coop will be
less money in the long run.

It seems everyone turns to Google these days and we see visitors to our site who have searched for;-

                                                                 CHICKEN COOP BUYING GUIDE

When buying a chicken coop, you will need to consider several important factors such as size,
appearance, strength, materials, usability etc….


Material

The main options will be timber or plastic. Plastic chicken coops have many benefits over wooden
coops, although, wooden coops are mostly chosen because of the traditional style and price
unfortunately they have a lot against them, particularly how hard it is to give them a proper clean

## CHICKEN COOPS - WOOD V PLASTIC - WHICH DO YOU CHOOSE?

Perhaps the biggest decision when getting chickens will be the coop, the hen coop needs to provide a
safe house for your new brood, be easy to clean and last a long time.

In the contest for the best chicken coop design the material it is constructed from will play a very
large part so; which material is the best, the safest, most durable, longest lasting and easiest to
clean…? Let's take a look…Appearance 

If you are on our website, we are going to assume you are a pragmatic buyer wanting a strong coop to
last a long time so it’s likely that looks are not top of your buying criteria, that said we still
think our plastic coops look good in the traditional hen house style, not like something out of the
Lakeland catalogue… have a look at our gallery to see for yourselves. 

 

Coop Cleanliness 

Healthy chickens need a healthy coop! An easy to clean home helps to prevent poorly birds, stops
disease spreading and may even increase the number of eggs you get! Humans know that the healthier
our homes, the healthier our children - why not the same for our hens?

When it’s new your Timber hen house can look good, there is no doubting that but as it gets older
how clean will it keep? Whether you have had experience with trying to clean a timber chicken coop
before or even just experience with cleaning your patio furniture or maintaining your garden fence
you know timber isn’t easy to clean and the ongoing painting is a nuisance. Without maintenance (and
even eventually with) rot sets in - even whilst quite new timber starts to soften, it absorbs
moisture - the perfect environment for bacteria and pathogens. 

 

Getting a pressure washer out for chicken coop used to be the thing of dreams! But with a well-built
plastic coop a quick blast is all that is needed. Try it with a wooden coop and you can kiss goodbye
to your investment or at the very least have a soggy timber house to return your brood to. Plastic
is the best way to go if you want to maintain a disease-free environment, with smooth surfaces that
don’t let in the pathogens or bacteria and are easy to clean.

Chicken Coop Strength

You don't need to be a rocket scientist to know that plastic is stronger than timber, many products
that used to be made from wood are now made from thinner plastics and are more robust - our coops
are made from plastic board which is thicker than most manufacturers timber! The best of both
worlds! Wood can crack, split, warp, swell, splinter, rot… the list goes on and on….. whilst plastic
will literally last forever… and without maintenance! 

So for strength it has to be plastic every time, you can literally take a sledgehammer to ours
without causing damage. That's why we offer the longest guarantees, what is there to go wrong?  No
wood to rot, no fixings to rust. We know our coops will be here much longer than we will!

 

Weatherproof 

Any coop when it’s brand new should keep out the rain, the question comes after a year or two and
the timber or roofing felt has deteriorated or the paint worn off.

Damp conditions in a coop will lead to all sorts of problems with your hens but also mean you end up
adding extra bedding and then being faced with layers of wet straw on clean out time. Do yourself
(and your hens) a favour and choose a material which is inherently waterproof to start with. 

 

Plastic Chicken Coop Costs 

Money will always come into your buying decision, so which is cheapest….? The original outlay on a
timber coop may well be less but the whole life costs will be significantly more. Value is the
initial price plus any maintenance cost divided by the lifespan, when you do this, you soon see
which is most cost efficient. The interesting thing that has never been considered is resale value.
With a plastic coop dismantled and scrubbed it is as good as new, ready to be advertised on Ebay and
sent via a courier.

 

Obviously, there are different levels of quality of timber houses available and lifespans can be
argued but using our experience and being very modest with saying a plastic coop will last only
twice as long these are some example figures. Whichever way you look at it, a plastic coop will be
less money in the long run.

cable-based systems that typically need replacement every 3-5 years. [Learn more about door
lifespan][89].

### How does your automatic chicken door work?

Our automatic coop door features Dawn-to-Dusk (a.k.a. Dusk-to-Dawn), Time Schedule, or manual
operation giving you complete flexibility. Dawn and Dusk delays can be set, and the Daylight Value
that triggers the door can be adjusted using the keypad menu. The door automatically opens and
closes based on your chosen settings.

### How can your automatic chicken door be predator-proof?

Coop Tender uses a solid 5/8" steel worm drive mechanism attached directly to the door. When closed,
nothing can open it—not raccoons, bears, or any other predator. It's similar to a screw-driven
garage door. The door construction, including the solid wood frame, cannot be penetrated by
predators.

### Will the door work in extreme cold or heat?

Yes. Coop Tender doors are rated for -20°F to 185°F operation. Unlike mechanical timers that freeze
in winter, our digital micro-controller technology ensures reliable operation in all weather. The
built-in Freeze Protect feature can be programmed to keep the door closed when temperatures drop
dangerously low to protect your flock.

### What powers your automatic chicken coop door?

Our doors run on either AC electrical power or solar energy. Solar doors include a battery that
stores energy (3-4 hours of sunlight per day is sufficient). AC-powered doors consume only 1 watt
and can include an optional backup battery for 5+ days of operation during power outages. [View
solar options][90].

and secure with 4 mounting screws (included). No assembly required—the door arrives ready to install
and operate. [View installation guide][91].

Yes. With the optional WiFi module, you can monitor and control your door from anywhere in the world
using our Universal Web App. Get real-time status updates, receive SMS/email alerts, adjust
schedules, and view temperature, battery, and door status charts. WiFi module can be added anytime.
[Learn about WiFi features][92].

## INNOVATIONS FOR AGRICULTURE

Happy chickens **scratching around outdoors** , pecking for worms and seeds, **happily and
contentedly laying eggs** , leaving neither parasites nor occasional nitrate contamination in their
environment. A mobile coop makes it possible. **This is an idea that makes chicken farmers and
consumers alike happy.**

The STARTER-plus is the ideal entry point into the business of mobile hen house eggs at a
professional level. And now we have optimized it even further: by popular demand, the STARTER-plus
now has a second gear. This means you can now reach into the aviary from both sides and have an even
better overview. **And so the STARTER-plus becomes the new STARTER-S!**

people who are touched by them can go out and educate others.

photographing our relationship with animals around the world for over 15 years now. This is one of
the most important things about sanctuaries that we have to take into account, you rescue animals,
and you invite people to meet the individuals.


They might come here and decide to eat fewer animals, or go vegan. Or they might go out into the
world a changed person. They might become an activist. How can you possibly put a dollar sign on
that? You can't.


It changed me. And as I said, it set me on this path of activism for life. And I have reached
millions of people now through my work because I was inspired by sanctuary.


Farm Sanctuary has been a touchstone for so many people who have gone on to do amazing activism.
Some of them have founded organizations. Some travel the world exposing cruelty and educating people
about what humans do to other animals.


I did furniture moving for like 16 years in the five boroughs. I knew nothing about farms, man. So
she asked me, hey, can you help me with this little piglet. I fell in love like instantly. So all
that Spanish stuff, eating pork my whole life went right out the window, man. Any rescues, any
emergencies, yeah, I'm there for them.


So I haven't had an animal food product since the day after my heart attack. With distance from the
eating machine and propaganda, I was able to kind of see, oh, there's a whole completely different
way to live, ironically healthier.


It took me my first 10 years before I became a vegan for ethical reasons. Seeing them in this
environment being well cared for, it can be life changing.


Part of coming here to Farm Sanctuary made me aware of these invisible animals, as I call them, and
that they're not represented. We don't see them. And how can we start to consider them at all if
we're not seeing them and talking about them.


Sanctuary to me just meant a safe haven. All beings deserve that. We have people who are escaping
horrible situations. Animals that are escaping horrible situations and need they need that
sanctuary.


Every animal should be in one, and every person too.


This part of Western New York was not too far from the roots of the Underground Railroad. And when
Farm Sanctuary first got this property, I felt pretty good knowing that this tradition of liberating
individuals from oppression and exploitation had been part of this area.


Providing a level of education so people can mindfully change their actions works to the goal of
rescuing all the animals.


You know, Farm Sanctuary is a place. But it's also a mission. The idea is to rescue individuals and
then ultimately to change the world.

Featured Rescue Stories

## Meet our Rescued Residents

[Blue pig at Farm Sanctuary]

Blue

[ Read his story ][62]
With one look into Blue’s bright, expressive sky-blue eyes, it’s easy to see why he won the heart of
the compassionate and brave student who spoke up for him.
[June B. Free and Susan cows eating hay at Sanctuary]

June B. Free & Susan

[ Read their story ][63]
In June 2021, 40 cows escaped a slaughterhouse and ran for their lives. Most were rounded up and
returned to slaughter—but two lucky survivors were released to Farm Sanctuary.
[Elli sheep standing in a green pasture with a valley behind her]

Elli

[ Read her story ][64]
The slaughterhouse workers called her “95.” They had painted that number on her side, marking her
for death. But the sheep we now call Elli had other plans.
[Tilly hen considers the camera with green grass behind her]

Tilly

[ Read her story ][65]
Tilly was born with a cross beak and needs specialized care to eat and survive—something she
wouldn’t get on a factory farm. Ironically, this saved her life.
[Rad, Dobie, and Macka ducks explore the grass at Sanctuary]

Macka, Milo, Dobie, & Rad

[ Read their story ][66]
A case of “fowl play” landed four ducklings in jail. Macka, Milo, Dobie, and Rad were abandoned in
the cold by a prison dumpster. Without help, they wouldn’t live to spring.
[Tutu turkey at Farm Sanctuary]

Tutu

[ Read her story ][67]
It’s been said that art imitates life—but in the case of Tutu turkey, art saved a couple of lives as
well.
[Hans in the snow at Farm Sanctuary]

Hans

[ Read his story ][68]
Hans was found wandering the streets on his own, likely after escaping slaughter. He was far from
the comforts of a warm, clean barn and protection from his herd—but he was alive.

## Imagine Sanctuary. Plan your Trip.

### Watkins Glen, NY

Nestled in the beautiful Finger Lakes Region of upstate New York, the rolling green pastures of Farm
Sanctuary’s 275-acre New York Sanctuary are home to nearly 400 rescued farm animals.

[ Learn More ][69]

### Los Angeles, CA

Our 39-acre Southern California Sanctuary — home to over 100 rescued farm animals — is located on a
beautiful hacienda ranch in Acton, just 45 minutes from Hollywood.

[ Learn More ][70]

## Sanctuary Happenings

—
* [Rescued goat Jake looks out from red barn at Farm Sanctuary]
  
  ### 2025 Impact Report
  
  With your steadfast support, Farm Sanctuary made meaningful progress for animals, people, and the
  planet in 2025.
  
  [View Report][71]
* [Hoedown]
  
  ### Hoedown: 40 Years
  
  This August 15-16, join us at Hoedown to go behind the scenes and see Farm Sanctuary like never
  before. Hurry and get your tickets today!
  
  [Register Now][72]
* [Rescued goat Hercules stands in pasture at Farm Sanctuary in front of red barns and fall foliage]
  
  ### 10 Milestone Moments From 40 Years
  
  Farm Sanctuary began with a single rescue and has grown into a driving force for compassionate
  change. Let’s look back at 10 pivotal moments.
  
  [Read & Share][73]
* [Staff sweeping pasture at Farm Sanctuary Ca]
  
  ### A Morning at Farm Sanctuary
  
  At Farm Sanctuary’s California shelter, we care for over 100 rescued farm animals. Senior Wellness
  Manager, Brooke, shares how our busy days begin.
  
  [Sanctuary in Action][74]
* [Explore.org live cam]
  
  ### Watch Live: Sheep Barn Cam
  
  Spend time with our rescued farm animal residents from the comfort of your own home. Tune into our
  live cams on Explore.org!
  
  [Watch Now][75]
* [Newsweek]
  
  ### A Win for the Animals!
  
  Farm Sanctuary is thrilled to share that our Los Angeles shelter has won a Newsweek Readers’
  Choice Award for “Best Animal Encounter!”
  
  [Good News][76]

actually started perking up and then she stood up. And she lived with us for more than 10 years. And
she's actually buried up on the farm right now.


It's not possible for sanctuaries to rescue all the animals who are currently being exploited and
slaughtered. So we need to change the system. And farm sanctuaries play a very important role in
modeling a different kind of relationship with other animals. The animals become ambassadors. And
people who are touched by them can go out and educate others.


I want everyone to cozy up. My name is Jo-Anne McArthur. I'm a photojournalist. I've been
photographing our relationship with animals around the world for over 15 years now. This is one of
the most important things about sanctuaries that we have to take into account, you rescue animals,
and you invite people to meet the individuals.


They might come here and decide to eat fewer animals, or go vegan. Or they might go out into the
world a changed person. They might become an activist. How can you possibly put a dollar sign on
that? You can't.


It changed me. And as I said, it set me on this path of activism for life. And I have reached
millions of people now through my work because I was inspired by sanctuary.


Farm Sanctuary has been a touchstone for so many people who have gone on to do amazing activism.
Some of them have founded organizations. Some travel the world exposing cruelty and educating people
about what humans do to other animals.


I did furniture moving for like 16 years in the five boroughs. I knew nothing about farms, man. So
she asked me, hey, can you help me with this little piglet. I fell in love like instantly. So all
that Spanish stuff, eating pork my whole life went right out the window, man. Any rescues, any
emergencies, yeah, I'm there for them.


So I haven't had an animal food product since the day after my heart attack. With distance from the
eating machine and propaganda, I was able to kind of see, oh, there's a whole completely different
way to live, ironically healthier.


It took me my first 10 years before I became a vegan for ethical reasons. Seeing them in this
environment being well cared for, it can be life changing.


Part of coming here to Farm Sanctuary made me aware of these invisible animals, as I call them, and
that they're not represented. We don't see them. And how can we start to consider them at all if
we're not seeing them and talking about them.


Sanctuary to me just meant a safe haven. All beings deserve that. We have people who are escaping
horrible situations. Animals that are escaping horrible situations and need they need that
sanctuary.


Every animal should be in one, and every person too.


This part of Western New York was not too far from the roots of the Underground Railroad. And when
Farm Sanctuary first got this property, I felt pretty good knowing that this tradition of liberating
individuals from oppression and exploitation had been part of this area.


Providing a level of education so people can mindfully change their actions works to the goal of
rescuing all the animals.


You know, Farm Sanctuary is a place. But it's also a mission. The idea is to rescue individuals and
then ultimately to change the world.

## Meet our Rescued Residents

[Blue pig at Farm Sanctuary]

Blue

[ Read his story ][62]
With one look into Blue’s bright, expressive sky-blue eyes, it’s easy to see why he won the heart of
the compassionate and brave student who spoke up for him.
[June B. Free and Susan cows eating hay at Sanctuary]

June B. Free & Susan

[ Read their story ][63]
In June 2021, 40 cows escaped a slaughterhouse and ran for their lives. Most were rounded up and
returned to slaughter—but two lucky survivors were released to Farm Sanctuary.
[Elli sheep standing in a green pasture with a valley behind her]

Elli

[ Read her story ][64]
The slaughterhouse workers called her “95.” They had painted that number on her side, marking her
for death. But the sheep we now call Elli had other plans.
[Tilly hen considers the camera with green grass behind her]

Tilly

[ Read her story ][65]
Tilly was born with a cross beak and needs specialized care to eat and survive—something she
wouldn’t get on a factory farm. Ironically, this saved her life.
[Rad, Dobie, and Macka ducks explore the grass at Sanctuary]

Macka, Milo, Dobie, & Rad

[ Read their story ][66]
A case of “fowl play” landed four ducklings in jail. Macka, Milo, Dobie, and Rad were abandoned in
the cold by a prison dumpster. Without help, they wouldn’t live to spring.
[Tutu turkey at Farm Sanctuary]

Tutu

[ Read her story ][67]
It’s been said that art imitates life—but in the case of Tutu turkey, art saved a couple of lives as
well.
[Hans in the snow at Farm Sanctuary]

Hans

[ Read his story ][68]
Hans was found wandering the streets on his own, likely after escaping slaughter. He was far from
the comforts of a warm, clean barn and protection from his herd—but he was alive.

Yes, we offer delivery around Ontario. Please contact us for a delivery estimate, or place an order

### What size coop should I get?

We suggest picking your coop size based on the number of eggs you'd like to collect each week.

eggs:

6x8 (up to 10 chickens): 60 eggs per week
6x12 (up to 15 chickens): 90 eggs per week
6x16 (up to 20 chickens): 120 eggs per week

You can pick up your coop from our warehouse near **Meaford, Ontario**. To schedule a pickup, please
first purchase a coop online.

All of our in-stock coops measure 6 feet in width, ensuring they fit on full-sized flat-bed
trailers. Coops are fork-lifted onto the trailer during pickup, so please ensure your trailer has
unobstructed sides.

  Our carpenters have studied and perfected the chicken coop craftsmanship. We build proper outdoor
  structures with quality Canadian materials.
* ### Comfort
  
  For both you and the chickens! All of our coops feature full-footprint outdoor runs and full-size
  doors.

[A basket of Ontario chicken coop eggs placed in a pile of fall leaves.]

## Taste the difference of farm-fresh eggs.

Enjoy farm-fresh eggs that are rich in flavor and packed with nutrients. Raise your hens in a
healthy, natural environment, free from hormones and antibiotics, and enjoy the freshest eggs
possible.

[ Purchase Your Coop ][18]

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do you deliver?

Yes, we offer delivery around Ontario. Please contact us for a delivery estimate, or place an order
and we'll reach out with a delivery quote!

### What size coop should I get?

We suggest picking your coop size based on the number of eggs you'd like to collect each week.
Assuming a chicken lays 6 eggs a week, our standard coop sizes will yield the following amount of
eggs:

6x8 (up to 10 chickens): 60 eggs per week
6x12 (up to 15 chickens): 90 eggs per week
6x16 (up to 20 chickens): 120 eggs per week

### Where is pickup?

You can pick up your coop from our warehouse near **Meaford, Ontario**. To schedule a pickup, please
first purchase a coop online.

### Will a coop fit on my trailer?

All of our in-stock coops measure 6 feet in width, ensuring they fit on full-sized flat-bed
trailers. Coops are fork-lifted onto the trailer during pickup, so please ensure your trailer has
unobstructed sides.

# Welcome to Gleneagles

Gleneagles is one of Scotland’s most iconic luxury hotels, where unrivalled country pursuits and
untold glamour have reigned for over a century. With 850 acres to explore, there are endless family
adventures to enjoy across our lochs, glens and golf courses, while indoors, there is the perfect
couples’ retreat in our spa, plus cocktails by candlelight, live piano in The Strathearn and
Michelin-starred dining to revel in until the wee hours.

 

STAY WITH US

## Stay

From our cosiest snugs to our grandest quarters, each of our 205 individually designed rooms and 28
suites has been meticulously crafted with comfort – and the perfect night’s sleep – in mind. Unwrap
the robes and unwind: welcome to our 5-star hotel, welcome home.

[Explore More][191]

FAMILY HOLIDAYS

Gather The Clan

Bringing bundles of energy, we know little ones need plenty of fun from a family-friendly hotel to
keep them out of mischief. It’s our pleasure to make them feel just as special as their grown-ups
with a fully-packed programme of outdoor adventures and in-house delights.

[Explore More][192]

UP TO 20% OFF

Short & Sweet

Stay with us for two nights or more mid-week, between now and October 2026, and enjoy up to 20% off
the best available rate in one of our beautiful rooms or suites.

[Book Now][193]

SCOTLAND’S BEST DINING EXPERIENCES

Eat & Drink

Our unique restaurants and bars span candlelit dining rooms to a cosy clubhouse. Beautifully
designed, they offer the perfect backdrops for everything from special family celebrations or
post-round drinks to romantic dinners and cosy nightcaps.

[Explore More][194]

Gleneagles Sporting Club is home to our equestrian centre, tennis, climbing and the fastest-growing
racquet sport in the world, padel. With a bright, spacious and relaxing lounge area dressed in
classic country club style, it’s a space to enjoy a coffee whilst catching up on emails or just
kicking back in style when a well-deserved break is in order after a hard-fought match on the
courts.

[Discover More][195]

Experiences

ACTIVITIES FOR EVERY GENERATION

Country Pursuits

Our world-class instructors are on hand to help sharpen skills or teach new tricks. From fishing on
the River Tay to hawking in the hills, our far-reaching run of heritage pursuits each offers a
timeless way to enjoy Scotland’s great outdoors.

[Explore More][196]

MOVE, RECOVER & RESTORE

Spa & Wellness

Whether you like your wellness at 6am in our state-of-the-art gym or at 4pm in our spa, our
Gleneagles leisure facilities offer something for everyone: Make a splash with the kids, explore our
adults-only thermal suite, book into an invigorating class or spoil yourself with a treatment from
our exceptional therapists.

[Explore More][197]

YOUR HOME FOR GOLF IN SCOTLAND

### Golf

Guests are warmly welcomed to our clubhouse at the foot of the Ochil Hills. With three bucket-list
championship courses and an unparalleled golfing experience, it’s no coincidence that Gleneagles is
the only venue in Europe to have hosted both the Ryder and Solheim Cups. Resident guests benefit
from a special rate, with club hire available too.

[Explore More][198]

Meetings & Occasions

AN UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCE

Occasions & Events

An occasion worth celebrating calls for a setting worth savouring. From wonderful weddings and
private parties to sensational shindigs and glorious gatherings, Gleneagles knows how to put on a
show for the good and the great of your world.

[Explore More][199]

A DESTINATION FOR HISTORIC MEETINGS

# Welcome to Gleneagles

Gleneagles is one of Scotland’s most iconic luxury hotels, where unrivalled country pursuits and
untold glamour have reigned for over a century. With 850 acres to explore, there are endless family
adventures to enjoy across our lochs, glens and golf courses, while indoors, there is the perfect
couples’ retreat in our spa, plus cocktails by candlelight, live piano in The Strathearn and
Michelin-starred dining to revel in until the wee hours.

 

STAY WITH US

## Stay

From our cosiest snugs to our grandest quarters, each of our 205 individually designed rooms and 28
suites has been meticulously crafted with comfort – and the perfect night’s sleep – in mind. Unwrap
the robes and unwind: welcome to our 5-star hotel, welcome home.

[Explore More][191]

FAMILY HOLIDAYS

Gather The Clan

Bringing bundles of energy, we know little ones need plenty of fun from a family-friendly hotel to
keep them out of mischief. It’s our pleasure to make them feel just as special as their grown-ups
with a fully-packed programme of outdoor adventures and in-house delights.

[Explore More][192]

UP TO 20% OFF

Short & Sweet

Stay with us for two nights or more mid-week, between now and October 2026, and enjoy up to 20% off
the best available rate in one of our beautiful rooms or suites.

[Book Now][193]

SCOTLAND’S BEST DINING EXPERIENCES

Eat & Drink

Our unique restaurants and bars span candlelit dining rooms to a cosy clubhouse. Beautifully
designed, they offer the perfect backdrops for everything from special family celebrations or
post-round drinks to romantic dinners and cosy nightcaps.

[Explore More][194]

Gleneagles Sporting Club is home to our equestrian centre, tennis, climbing and the fastest-growing
racquet sport in the world, padel. With a bright, spacious and relaxing lounge area dressed in
classic country club style, it’s a space to enjoy a coffee whilst catching up on emails or just
kicking back in style when a well-deserved break is in order after a hard-fought match on the
courts.

[Discover More][195]

Experiences

ACTIVITIES FOR EVERY GENERATION

Country Pursuits

Our world-class instructors are on hand to help sharpen skills or teach new tricks. From fishing on
the River Tay to hawking in the hills, our far-reaching run of heritage pursuits each offers a
timeless way to enjoy Scotland’s great outdoors.

[Explore More][196]

MOVE, RECOVER & RESTORE

Spa & Wellness

Whether you like your wellness at 6am in our state-of-the-art gym or at 4pm in our spa, our
Gleneagles leisure facilities offer something for everyone: Make a splash with the kids, explore our
adults-only thermal suite, book into an invigorating class or spoil yourself with a treatment from
our exceptional therapists.

[Explore More][197]

YOUR HOME FOR GOLF IN SCOTLAND

### Golf

Guests are warmly welcomed to our clubhouse at the foot of the Ochil Hills. With three bucket-list
championship courses and an unparalleled golfing experience, it’s no coincidence that Gleneagles is
the only venue in Europe to have hosted both the Ryder and Solheim Cups. Resident guests benefit
from a special rate, with club hire available too.

[Explore More][198]

Meetings & Occasions

AN UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCE

Occasions & Events

An occasion worth celebrating calls for a setting worth savouring. From wonderful weddings and
private parties to sensational shindigs and glorious gatherings, Gleneagles knows how to put on a
show for the good and the great of your world.

[Explore More][199]

A DESTINATION FOR HISTORIC MEETINGS

Meetings

Business has been done, treaties have been signed and reputations have been made at Gleneagles for
over a century. Follow suit with your own meeting of the minds, making use of our inspirational

## Intelligently designed, sustainable coops

We believe in making high-quality, long-lasting products to minimise our impact on the planet, and
work with green energy to create eco-friendly chicken coops.

The recycled plastic we use provides an ideal habitat for chickens and offers a range of qualities
that put Nestera chicken coops head and shoulders above traditional wooden ones.

## Knowledge Centre

We’re dedicated to sharing our expertise and the joy of (re)connecting with nature.

Our [Learn][91] page is your go-to source for chicken info, and includes our [Blog][92], which is

customers and professional breeders.

## **We’re With You Every Step of the Way.**

From your first chicks to a thriving flock, we’ve got guides, tools, and real experts ready to help.

[ Visit the Learning Center ➜ ][96]

## Built for Your Flock. Rooted in Community.

At RentACoop, we’re here to make chicken ownership simple, joyful, and meaningful. Our innovative,
high-quality products are designed on our farm to support healthy, happy chickens—so you can focus
on the moments that matter most.

But our mission goes beyond products. We believe the hands-on experience of hatching and raising
chickens can be truly life-changing.

That’s why we proudly give back to our community, supporting local public schools, 4-H and 4-H
Camps, The Salvation Army, Habitat for Humanity, and more. With over $200,000 donated, we’re
committed to helping inspire the next generation of chicken keepers.

## Built for Your Flock. Rooted in Community.

At RentACoop, we’re here to make chicken ownership simple, joyful, and meaningful. Our innovative,
high-quality products are designed on our farm to support healthy, happy chickens—so you can focus
on the moments that matter most.

But our mission goes beyond products. We believe the hands-on experience of hatching and raising
chickens can be truly life-changing.

That’s why we proudly give back to our community, supporting local public schools, 4-H and 4-H
Camps, The Salvation Army, Habitat for Humanity, and more. With over $200,000 donated, we’re
committed to helping inspire the next generation of chicken keepers.

### Day of Service 2026

Three sites. One day. Join us for Solid Ground’s 3rd annual Day of Service – a morning of hands-on
projects rooted in care, connection, and collective action.

[Sign Up Now!][41]
[Two teen girls hug and grin. They're standing in front of a brick wall and wearing backpacks.]

### Pack It Forward!

Support students for a strong start! Donate to our Pack It Forward School Supply Drive from Monday,
July 27 – Thursday, August 13, 2026.

[Browse Wishlist][42]
[Woman with dark shoulder-length hair wearing a yellow blazer and white blouse gestures with her
hands while speaking into the microphone.]

### From our CEO: No one thrives alone

"Community care isn’t just a feeling – it’s a choice we make together through the policies we
support." ~Shalimar Gonzales

[Read Message][43]
[Collage of photos showing women serving food from a buffet to children and families, plus dinner
foods and desserts.]

### Breaking bread, building connection

The Collaborative Cooking program at Broadview Shelter & Transitional Housing plays a critical role
helping domestic violence survivors build new social and support networks to help their healing.

[Read Story][44]

### Day of Service 2026

Three sites. One day. Join us for Solid Ground’s 3rd annual Day of Service – a morning of hands-on
projects rooted in care, connection, and collective action.

[Sign Up Now!][47]

At Solid Ground, we believe poverty is solvable. We work to meet basic needs, nurture success, and
promote change to create a community beyond poverty and oppression where all people have equitable
opportunity to thrive.
